en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammapaccanīyānuloma (4), Tikatikapaṭṭhānapāḷi (5) 23.1.
Kusala-ttika, Vedanā-ttika
Homage to that Blessed One, the Worthy One, the Perfectly Enlightened One.

Dependent on a non-wholesome state associated with a feeling other than pleasure, a non-wholesome state associated with a pleasant feeling arises by way of the root condition. [Dependent on] a non-wholesome state associated with a feeling other than pleasure...
Conditioned by a neutral state associated with pleasant feeling, a neutral state associated with pleasant feeling arises by way of root condition... two [cases].
Conditioned by a state that is neither unwholesome nor associated with unpleasant feeling, a wholesome state associated with pleasant feeling arises by way of root condition.
Conditioned by a state that is neither unwholesome nor associated with unpleasant feeling... [and so on].
Conditioned by an indeterminate state associated with pleasant feeling, an indeterminate state associated with pleasant feeling arises by way of root condition … two.

Conditioned by an indeterminate state not associated with pleasant feeling, a wholesome state associated with pleasant feeling arises by way of root condition. Conditioned by an indeterminate state not associated with pleasant feeling … [and so on].
Dependent on a state that is unwholesome and associated with pleasant feeling, a state that is unwholesome and associated with pleasant feeling arises by way of root condition … two.

Dependent on a state that is neither-unwholesome-nor-associated-with-pleasant-feeling and neither-indeterminate-nor-associated-with-pleasant-feeling, a state that is unwholesome and associated with pleasant feeling arises by way of root condition … one.

Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor associated with pleasant feeling, and neither indeterminate nor associated with pleasant feeling, a wholesome state associated with pleasant feeling arises by way of root condition … one.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor associated with pleasant feeling, and neither unwholesome nor associated with pleasant feeling,
an indeterminate state associated with pleasant feeling arises by way of root condition.
… one. (Abbreviated.
Nine by way of root … pe … three by way of result … pe … nine by way of non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor associated with painful feeling, there arises an unwholesome state associated with painful feeling by way of root-condition … one.
Dependent on a state that is neither-indeterminate-nor-associated-with-painful-feeling, an unwholesome state associated with painful feeling arises by way of root-condition … one.
Dependent on a state that is neither-unwholesome-nor-associated-with-painful-feeling and neither-indeterminate-nor-associated-with-painful-feeling,
an unwholesome state associated with painful feeling arises by way of root-condition.
… one. (Abbreviated.
Under root-condition there are three … pe … under non-disappearance-condition there are three.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, [arises] an unwholesome [state] associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling … [and so forth].
A state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arises by way of root condition dependent on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling that is neither-unwholesome.

A neutral (abyākata) state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arises by way of root condition dependent on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling that is neither-unwholesome. ... two.
Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling,
there arises a wholesome state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, there arises an indeterminate state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling...
...arises by way of root condition ... two.

Dependent on a non-indeterminate state that is not associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, a wholesome state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arises by way of root condition. Dependent on a non-indeterminate state that is not associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling...
Dependent on a state associated with feeling of pain, there arises an unwholesome state associated with neither-pain-nor-pleasure feeling by way of root condition … two.
[Dependent on] a state that is neither unwholesome nor associated with neither-pain-nor-pleasure feeling, and neither indeterminate nor associated with neither-pain-nor-pleasure feeling … [two].

Dependent on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling that is unwholesome, there arises a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of root condition … one.
Dependent on a state that is neither-unwholesome nor associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling and is neither-indeterminate nor associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling … one.

Dependent on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling that is unwholesome, a wholesome state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arises by way of root condition … one.

Dependent on a state that is neither-unwholesome nor associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, and which is neither-unwholesome nor associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling … [one].
Dependent on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, there arises a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of root condition … one. (Abbreviated.
Nine under root; … pe … three under result; … pe … nine under non-disappearance.
